public_brief: We run an online store doing about $30k/month, all US cards, on Stripe. Our processor fees feel too high and we want to reconsider. Compare the realistic options for a business our size and recommend one. Write your recommendation as a structured document: position up front, then reasoning, risks, and what would change your mind.

answer_sheet.answer: About $30k/month card volume, steady month to month.
We see maybe 2 chargebacks a year; fraud is not a pain point.
US-only cards for the foreseeable future.
No long-term contracts; month-to-month strongly preferred.
Out of scope - we are not accepting crypto.

rubric.name: constraint coverage
rubric.description: Uses the stated business facts correctly; no invented facts.

rubric.name: unstated-constraint handling
rubric.description: Names the decision-relevant unknowns (interchange, chargeback exposure, international needs, contract terms) as questions or assumptions rather than ignoring them.

rubric.name: quantified comparison
rubric.description: Compares options with concrete fee math at the stated volume, not adjectives.

rubric.name: risk treatment
rubric.description: Names the top risks of the recommendation with mitigations.

rubric.name: decisiveness
rubric.description: One clear recommendation with explicit revert conditions, not a hedge.

rubric.name: hallucination control
rubric.description: No invented statistics; uncertainty flagged where it is real.

provenance.derivation: Common SMB payment-processor decision; withheld facts mirror what a PM would actually know and be asked.
